summary: Escambia County, AL tower administered by the Alabama Forestry Commission; registered 2010 as US 873; build year 1938 or 1939 (the register disagrees with itself); no public access described.

facts.status_note: An online drone video calls the tower abandoned; the register page read does not state its condition

events.note: Register 'Built' field gives 1939; the register description says built in 1938

evidence.supports: 120-ft metal tower with 7x7 cab, built in 1938 (description)
evidence.quote: It is a 120' metal tower with 7'x7' cab built in 1938.

evidence.supports: 50th lookout listed on the NHLR in Alabama
evidence.quote: The honor of the 50th lookout listed on the NHLR in Alabama goes to the Mashmayer Lookout Tower.

evidence.supports: video description: abandoned tower, a few miles off I-65 via AL 113
evidence.quote: Drone video of abandoned Mashmayer Fire Tower located a few miles off of I 65 a few miles South on Al 113.

sources.title: Mashmayer Fire Lookout Tower (video description by JacksonsRamblings)

notes_for_editor: Only two sources. The register contradicts itself on the build year (Built field 1939, description 1938). Two web searches and the 2018 FFLA Alabama report found nothing else on this tower. The Rumble page is premium-only video; only its text description was read, not the video. The record's status 'standing' is not stated by the register page read, and the video calls the tower abandoned; the story now says only that the tower is near Pineview, and a recent photo should be checked before any status is published. Access is unknown and no visit facts are given. Wikidata item Q86926151 exists but has no date, so it is not cited. Worth asking the Alabama Forestry Commission for its tower records.
